title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description: Entry-level DevOps position focused on foundational Linux, containerization, CI/CD, and cloud skills. Expected to automate basic tasks, manage containers, and support CI/CD pipelines under guidance.

skills.rationale: Foundation for all DevOps work; daily Linux usage is non-negotiable
Version control is fundamental to all code and configuration management
Containerization is an industry standard; Dockerfile and Compose are daily tasks
Bash/Python scripting for automation is a core daily activity
Building and maintaining basic CI/CD pipelines is expected
Understanding DNS, HTTP, SSH, and basic troubleshooting is essential
Familiarity with at least one cloud provider is increasingly required
Basic IaC understanding is a strong differentiator for juniors
Growing expectation but deep knowledge is mid-level; basic pod/deployment understanding helps
Understanding basic monitoring concepts and reading dashboards
Useful but not always required at junior level; varies by company
Awareness-level; understanding basics of secrets management and dependency scanning
Aspirational for juniors; understanding concepts is enough

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Some foundations in place, needs focused learning

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Most foundational skills present, some gaps to fill

exceeds.description: Exceeds junior-level expectations; may be ready for mid-level
